reason: One line saying 'GDPR-compliant' is not enough for me to plug my customer list and inbox into AI from a company I've never heard of. I might poke at the free plan, but I won't add another 99 € subscription to Friday's invoice pile until I know where my data sits and that it actually saves me hours.
objection: Where is my customer data stored and processed, who can see it, and is it used to train AI models? If something leaks, my clients blame me, not the software.
would_change_my_mind: A signed data processing agreement with EU-only hosting and no training on my data, plus a free month on the Standard plan with a cancel-anytime monthly option so I can see real time saved before paying.
